toolTexts.listRunningAgents: List the agents and agent teams that a person started and that run now, so you can message them; this list is for messages only: to start work, use delegate_task. Your own run and the task agents that delegate_task starts are not listed. Each entry has its kind (agent or agent_team), name, address, state (running, idle or error) and, when it has them, started_at, project (the Project it was started under) and workspace (the folder it works in, which tells you which project's work it does). Message an agent with send_message_to and its agent_run_id; message an agent team through its coordinator: send_message_to with its team_coordinator_agent_run_id. With node, list what runs on that peer node: each entry then has node, and you pass the same node to send_message_to. Stopped runs are not listed, and a message never wakes them. This tool is read-only.
